Ana, saw PandaDoc shipped an AI-native MCP server to take on Docusign, with more product advancements lined up for 2026.

I built a personalized signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Ana, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

Going head-to-head with incumbents across 60,000-plus organizations, demand often outpaces what the team can ramp to cover. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to capitalize on it, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PandaDoc needs to ride this push, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ana, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?

Ana, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the 2026 advancements roll out, no problem at all. Timing is everything around a product push, and that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
